HTH Tours (HTH Travel Services Pvt. Ltd.) is a Guwahati-based tour operator specialising in Northeast India holidays. We design private and group tour packages across Assam, Meghalaya, Arunachal Pradesh, Nagaland, Sikkim and Darjeeling - from Kaziranga National Park safaris and Meghalaya's living root bridges, Cherrapunji, Dawki and Mawlynnong, to Tawang, Shillong and the Hornbill Festival. As a government-approved (Ministry of Tourism) travel company, we handle everything end to end: inner-line permits, handpicked hotels, private cabs, experienced local guides and round-the-clock support. Whether it's a weekend getaway, a honeymoon, or a multi-week Northeast circuit, we build the itinerary around your dates and budget.

We, a group of four womens, recently completed a 13‑day trip to Arunachal Pradesh, Meghalaya, and Assam with HTH Tours, guided by tour advisor Ritik Boruah. The entire plan was wonderfully organized, and it turned out to be a truly memorable journey filled with beautiful experiences.

We sincerely thank HTH and Ritik Boruah for their excellent service. The accommodations provided were very clean and comfortable, and the driver assigned to us took exceptional care throughout the trip. Driving in Arunachal Pradesh can be quite challenging due to the difficult and sometimes scary roads, but he handled everything with great skill and ensured our safety at all times.

This trip was not only well‑planned but also budget‑friendly, making it accessible without compromising on quality. We are grateful for the thoughtful arrangements and the attention to detail that made our journey so smooth.

We wholeheartedly recommend HTH Tours to everyone looking for a reliable, caring, and professional travel partner. Thank you once again for giving us such wonderful memories to cherish.

Thank you hritik ji for planning such a beautiful Tawang trip for us. Everything was smooth and well coordinated throughout the journey. Infact the coordination started before the actual trip began!

The stays were thoughtfully chosen, especially the offbeat properties, which made the experience feel even more special and authentic. The drivers were punctual, helpful, and very warm throughout the trip.

We had a wonderful experience traveling with your company for our Meghalaya trip. All arrangements were well planned and executed. The resorts and hotels were beautiful, neat, and located at very scenic places. Food arrangements were good as well.

Just two suggestions for improvement: the breakfast menu could have more variety as we were served the same item (chole puri) on multiple days, and the vehicle provided for transportation was quite compact, which made long-distance travel slightly uncomfortable.

Apart from these points, everything was excellent. All destinations mentioned in the brochure were covered, and the inclusions and exclusions were clearly communicated with no hidden surprises. The tour coordinator "Diya" and tour manager "Moon" were very cooperative and ensured the trip went smoothly.

Overall, it was a great experience and I would definitely recommend your company to friends and family traveling to North East. Looking forward to traveling with you again in the future.

I would like to sincerely appreciate the agency for their professional planning and seamless execution.
